recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is for the core specification. If the incorrect display remains reproducible in current generated IG pages, file or fix it in HL7/fhir-ig-publisher, using a minimal profile that constrains an extension Reference targetProfile as the test case.
issue_request: FHIR-12981 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request, auto-approved for R5, reporting that IGTool-generated profile pages displayed an extension's type without considering profile constraints on the referenced resource target profile.
initial_application: No exact FHIR-12981 source commit was found in this FHIR checkout or on the combined branch. The Jira record contains no linked core source patch; its later editor comment characterizes the item as an old tooling issue rather than a current FHIR source issue.
additional_context: The current FHIR source contains the normative profiling and extension-definition guidance, including extension slices by URL and targetProfile constraints in profile examples, but this repository does not contain IG Publisher Java renderer code. External GitHub code search locates targetProfile/type display renderer code in HL7/fhir-ig-publisher, matching the Jira comment's instruction to raise any remaining problem there.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR source file was changed because the requested behavior belongs to IG Publisher/profile rendering tooling outside this checkout, and no current core specification source location needs correction to satisfy the Jira request.
